meta.counts: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned
meta.time: About 200 hours to platinum (PowerPyx; Push Square says 250+)
meta.online: None — no online mode at launch, every trophy is single-player
meta.playthroughs: 1 — no mission replay, no New Game+, 15 manual save slots + 1 autosave
meta.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and stop the game saving (PowerPyx, Push Square)

sixshore.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

psnprofiles.label: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades)

truetrophies.label: TrueTrophies — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

roadmap.title: Play the story, do the side stuff as it appears
roadmap.text: Finish all 5 chapters and enjoy the game. There are no mission medals and no mission replay, so nothing needs a second run. Along the way: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (the one possibly missable trophy), take optional missions as they appear, scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study new animals through the binoculars — all of it counts toward the 100% checklist later. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter.

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist and the challenges
roadmap.text: After the credits the checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles are only partly required, and any 70 of the 80 challenges will do. The parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. This step is where the gold A Long Road and most silvers land.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and final cleanup
roadmap.text: Strangers & Freaks strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so finish the 8 counting strands now, along with the side-character questlines and any one-off trophies left (the UFO, the motorcycle kick, the Payday Loans mystery). The platinum pops when the last trophy does.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.when: Last — pops with the 54th other trophy
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are yours — there is no separate task. Work the list in roadmap order and this pops last. The long pole is A Long Road (100% completion), so plan around that one.
steps: Finish the story (Step 1)
Work the 100% checklist (Step 2)
Clean up Strangers & Freaks and the one-offs (Step 3)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, starts Chapter 1. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops when the mission completes. It cannot be missed.
steps: Start a new game
Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finishes Chapter 1. Chapter trophies pop a little late — PowerPyx notes this one lands once you clear the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. It cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 1
Start Chapter 2 — the trophy pops after its first mission

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finishes Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops just after the chapter turns, once you clear the first mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. It cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 2
Start Chapter 3 — the trophy pops after its first mission

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finishes Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. It cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 3
Clear the first two missions of Chapter 4

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finishes Chapter 4. It pops after the final mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'. It cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 4
Complete the final mission, 'Starting From Zero'

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final mission of the game. Clear the last main mission and the gold pops with the credits. Nothing else is needed, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play through all 5 chapters
Complete the final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play Chapter 2 until Breakfast Run appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play Chapter 3 until The Cartel Heist appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play Chapter 4 until Child's Play appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play Chapter 4 until Headliners appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play Chapter 4 until VCIA Takedown appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play Chapter 5 until Operation Savage Glory appears
Complete the mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.when: After the story — checklist opens at the credits
trophies.guide: The 100% completion checklist, found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx calls the list lenient — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles are only partly required, and you only need 70 of the 80 challenges. The parts that do need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Roughly 100 hours of the ~200-hour platinum.
steps: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion
Clear the checklist — robberies, ranges, drone races and Bret's target decks need everything
Pick any 70 of the 80 challenges; skip the hardest 10

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.when: Any time — start during the story
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix categories freely — flying under bridges is the quickest. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this one. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
steps: Pick the easiest category — under-the-bridge flights are fastest
Check progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts
Keep going to 300 if you are chasing 100%

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car, race challenge or drone race), and performing a stunt. The story introduces most of them, and the rest are marked when you unfog the map. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types you have done
Fill the gaps — golf, pool and basketball are the ones players usually miss

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: A gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The medals are not punishing, and the 100% checklist needs all of them too, so this is a Step 2 job — do it with the checklist, not before.
steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges
Earn gold in each of the 42 challenges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). The 100% checklist needs all of them as well, so clear them together with the checklist.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations
Win at least one race at each

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the 40 unique race locations. Any mix of car races, race challenges and drone races counts — but a win only counts once per location, so keep moving to new spots.
steps: Race at new locations — wins only count once per location
Keep going until 20 different wins

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui' introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple map icon). Follow his fishing questline to the challenge and out-fish him.
steps: Play Chapter 1 until you meet Cal in 'Feng Shui'
Wait for Cal's text with the fishing spot
Win the fishing challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games ('Video Games'): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it.
steps: Pick any of the 4 games — the home TV has the first three
Play through all its levels once

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's 5-quest strand, Lucia only. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and all stay available after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 until Andy calls
Follow the 5 quests in Belville

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving strand: clear 7 shipwrecks. It is marked in Chapter 1, after the mission 'Island Dreams'. Kenton marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map; dive with the metal detector, dig up the treasure and bring it back. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3, so it is not missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
steps: After 'Island Dreams', follow Kenton's calls to Key Lento
Dive the 7 shipwrecks and return each treasure
If he goes quiet, keep playing — he comes back in Chapter 2–3

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's 5-quest strand at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County, marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break'. The quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.
steps: After 'Coffee Break', head to the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County
Complete Billy's 5 quests

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Andy, Billy, Moses, Tyrone and Yasmani do not. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; PowerPyx notes more are still being found. Track your count in the trophy list, and leave this for Step 3 — none of it is missable.
steps: Find stranger strands in the open world after the story
Finish 8 that count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.count_note: 16 sports cars on the wish list
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list: deliver 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3 after 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', which also gives you the Key Cloner for high-end cars. Randy marks cars in fixed spots (often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach), or steal them off the street; scanning with WAiNK shows whether a car is on the list. Deliver in good condition for a better payout. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
steps: Finish 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' for the Key Cloner
Find the 16 cars Randy wants — scan with WAiNK to check
Deliver each one to Randy's garage

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand, Jason only. After the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty', purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy them in 'Take Out Kitty Litter', then Tyrone offers 'Spin On This' to shut the labs down. Still available after the story.
steps: Play as Jason after 'Here, Kitty Kitty'
Destroy the Synthetic Labs in 'Take Out Kitty Litter'
Complete 'Spin On This'

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.when: Chapter 1 — the first meditation is only here
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts twice. THE ONE TO WATCH: the first meditation is offered in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is gone after Chapter 1, so do it while it is there.
steps: Chapter 1, after 'Down to Earth': talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning
Follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation
Visit the other 18 spots (10 locations) with both characters

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel, Jason only. After the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', Bret texts Jason and marks 'Veteran Hunted' in Lummox County. His first quest gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle (recoverable at any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). Clear his target decks — there are 15, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this should come naturally. PowerPyx has not yet confirmed which animal triggers the trophy.
steps: Play as Jason after 'Coffee Break' until Bret texts
Meet Bret in Lummox County
Work through his 15 target decks

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.count_note: 3 full sets out of 18 set locations
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18 set locations. You do not need all 18 — only 3 full sets. Push Square notes the 100% checklist wants more of them (15 of 18 sets), so keep collecting after this pops.
steps: Find card sets across Leonida
Complete any 3 full sets
Keep collecting — the 100% checklist wants 15 of 18

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.when: Any time — start during the story
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1). Any mix counts: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags, with more than 100 in the world. You can scan while doing everything else — just point the app at anything interesting.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1)
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you pass them
Any 100 scans will do

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges, and save the hardest 10 for last — or skip them entirely.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see what you have done
Clear the easy ones first
Keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you. Available once Jason and Lucia can roam together (after Chapter 2, 'Coffee Break'): call your partner with Right + Triangle, cause enough chaos for 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone — a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the classic escape (cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you). It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults, which always trigger 4 stars.
steps: After 'Coffee Break', call your partner (Right + Triangle)
Build a 4-star wanted level
Escape the heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel is the easy way out

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Bring your partner, keep the flashing wanted level (not the red heat level), and loot 3 robbery targets in a row — the trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop, so give it a moment. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City are a good run, once they open after the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'; rob a few items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. If the police arrive too early, keep going to a fourth shop.
steps: Call your partner, then hit 3 shops in a row while wanted
Loot each properly — back-room safe included
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop for the pop

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.when: Any time — start during the story
trophies.count_note: 100 of 557 vehicles (100% needs 200 of 277 base models)
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Just scan them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops early. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
steps: Open WAiNK (hold Up, then R1)
Scan vehicles on a busy road
Any 100 unique vehicles will do

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). It slows time and highlights weak spots, but only lasts a few seconds, so buff your focus first — eat or drink, wash up at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Line up 5 gang members (at gang operations) and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by the endgame you will be at level 4 and this gets much easier.
steps: Raise Focus to level 4 (ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots)
Take Adrenaline, then trigger Combat Focus at a gang operation
Drop 5 gang members before the focus bar runs out

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure gate at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not one parked on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and walk straight in, or enter through the terminal on foot. Get in the cockpit, drive the plane back to the strip, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport before it pops.
steps: Head to VCIA terminals E3/E4
Board the docked passenger plane
Take off and fly 1 km from the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino). They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb in and shoot until it pops.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, Mariana County
Take a Rhino from the south of the base
Fire at enemies until the trophy pops

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it gives you the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies (green map icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets off the alarm), find the safe code on a note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
steps: Finish 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' for the Snap Gun
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun
Loot the safe, kill the footage and the alarm, then walk out

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. It opens with the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip to mark more security vans (finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first). Each vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike, then swap cars to lose the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'
Pay Yasmani for security-van tips
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' covers it automatically — robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing the truck. Or do it earlier: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door (find them in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests) and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray.
steps: Either play the Chapter 4 mission, or stop a truck yourself
Blow the back door with a sticky bomb
Escape the heat radius

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map across all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible.
steps: Get a plane
Fly over every fogged part of the map
Keep going until all 52 areas are clear

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you get near them (many are also marked by the story). You only need one per gang for the trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.
steps: Watch for yellow operation icons near gang turf
Rob one operation per gang
Keep going to all 39 for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing by the bar.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the window. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' to take it. The pop is slightly delayed — keep driving down the street after the crash. It is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3
Take the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom
Drive it through the window

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'. Inside: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery respawns after a while, so go back for what you missed.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation
Clear Kingpin Bowling: watch, shotgun, safe
Escape the police — the trophy pops then

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.note: Hidden status: PSNProfiles / TrueTrophies list this one hidden; Push Square does not mark it hidden.
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Available once you can switch between both characters (after Chapter 2, 'Coffee Break'). Buy a fitness club membership and always train together — call your partner (Right + Triangle) and while you work out, the other finishes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. Filter fitness clubs on the map under Activities.
steps: After 'Coffee Break', get a gym membership
Train with both characters together
Max out Strength on Jason and Lucia

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that change your criminal profile. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and you will see a small demon face whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — the last is permanent, so do not push the violence too far. It comes naturally across every robbery and fight; if anything is left at the end, it is the easiest farm in the game.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI
Play normally — every robbery and fight counts
Check the count on the trophy itself in the PS5 trophy list

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — try the Payday Loans jobs and locations if it has not popped for you. Marked unconfirmed: the method may change as guides pin it down.
steps: Try the Payday Loans store and its jobs (unconfirmed)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The UFO easter egg. Late at night (after 2AM), alone, on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, you may find a blinking car at the roadside. If it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path from the car into the woods and a UFO (bright blue light in the sky) drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside to finish it. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
steps: After 2AM, go alone to the road NW of Starlet Motel, Kelly County
Look for the blinking car; if absent, drive off and return
Follow the path into the woods, meet the UFO, help the woman, return to her car

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle — bowling someone over with a melee drive-by. Try melee kicks at pedestrians while riding a motorcycle. Marked unconfirmed: the method may change as guides pin it down.
steps: Ride a motorcycle and try melee kicks at pedestrians (unconfirmed)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' to get the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total adds up across robberies; you do not need $250,000 at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single job, so this comes naturally in Step 2.
steps: Finish 'Credit Check' for the Dye Pack Jammer
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills
Deliver the bills to a fence — Yasmani pays most

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — they are the priciest things in the game. It adds up across every shop type: 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
steps: Buy guns, car mods and tattoos — the priciest items
Keep spending across any shops until $100,000

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related and do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages open for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)', when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to raise the cash.
steps: Finish 'Daily Driver' to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app
Buy all 8 garages through the app

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)'. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes: each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. He only takes vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
steps: Finish 'Moses' to unlock the Scooter Bros app
Buy garage space first (see Little Boxes)
Drive 10 cheap vehicles to Moses and register them
